legal_form: קרן סגורה, קרן סל (Israeli ETF under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; units of 1 ₪ par value; units first offered to the public on 29.01.2024. Trustee: יובנק חברה לנאמנות בע"מ. REPLICATION: swap: mainly unfunded swaps on the tracking asset (annual report https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1723001-1724000/P1723806-00.pdf, p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'בכוונת מנהל הקרן ליצור חשיפה לנכס המעקב בעיקר באמצעות עסקאות החלף שאינן במימון על נכס המעקב'; read 2026-10-25).

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee (דמי ניהול קבועים): p. 1 'שכר מנהל הקרן: 0% מהשווי הנקי השנתי הממוצע של נכסי הקרן' (footnote 6: the manager committed to the ISA outline not to raise its pay during a calendar year; it may raise it on 01.01.2027). Expense table: fixed management fee 0.00% in 2025 and in 29.01.2024 to 31.12.2024. Main prospectus published on Magna on 14.12.2025, reference 2025-03-099273 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts). ISIN IL0012016569 and the TASE symbol 'ילינ.ס1' were read on TASE's security page (https://market.tase.co.il/he/market_data/security/1201656/major_data, fields 'ISIN' and 'סימול', read in Chrome on 2026-10-24); the annual report prints neither. The Maya fund page shows no data for ETFs.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. For 2025 the report prints the fund's price return 2.64% (standard deviation 18.96) against the tracking asset (S&P 500 100%, דולר ארה"ב 100%) 2.61% (standard deviation 20.57); for 29.01.2024 to 31.12.2024: 19.86% against 19.88%. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). Added 2026-10-25: the third-party page the report points to (chart.bursagraph.co.il / fundscenter.co.il, 'Funds Center' by Guideline) publishes the 12-month tracking difference under ETF-07(e), but states 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here; founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: No median bid-ask spread is printed. The report prints the differences between unit value and exchange price in 2025: range -5.46% to 9.42%, average -0.08% (in points: -302.61 to 504.48, average -5.094), a premium/discount measure (ETF-06). Spread data is published elsewhere (ETF-07; the report points to chart.bursagraph.co.il, a third-party page, not read). Creation fee 0.30% and redemption fee 0.30% on direct orders through a TASE member (p. 1).
